fields.System.Title: INV-903 — Reconcile the projection nightly
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want the availability projection compared against the real balances on a
schedule, so that drift is detected rather than served to customers.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the job runs, then every projection row is compared against the computed value
  • from balances.
  • - Given any mismatch, then it is reported with product, warehouse, projected, and actual.
  • - Given a mismatch, then an alert is raised and the rebuild is offered — but not run
  • automatically.
  • - Given a projection row older than the configured freshness threshold, then it is
  • reported as stale even if it matches.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | product_availability, stock_balance |
| Risks | Projection drift ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)); stale data served confidently ([doc 08 §5.3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
